description: A responsive image grid that displays 1 to 4 images in rectangle or square layouts. Each cell is rendered with `modus-wc-image` for consistent cropping, rounded corners, and fallback behavior. Grid layout CSS fills each cell; per-image dimensional `size` tokens on `modus-wc-image` are not exposed on `IImageGridImage`.

properties.name: images
properties.description: Images to display in the grid. Only the first N images are shown based on `imagesPerView`.

properties.name: imageShape
properties.description: Sets the cell aspect ratio layout.

properties.name: imagesPerView
properties.description: Maximum number of images to display in the grid (1–4).

properties.name: customClass
properties.description: Custom CSS class to apply to the grid container.
